records.Title: SOP – Safe maintenance workflow
records.Procedure / Guidance: Identify job → risk assessment/permit → LOTO → tools/spares verification → maintenance → inspection/measurement → trial run → handover.

records.Title: SOP – Shift log entry
records.Procedure / Guidance: Select exact equipment → enter shift/date → record observation → attach image → review/confirm → classify defect → assign action.

records.Title: SOP – Vibration/temperature monitoring
records.Procedure / Guidance: Select equipment and point → record H/V/A, temperature, RPM and operating condition → compare approved limit/trend → create action.

records.Title: SOP – Spare verification
records.Procedure / Guidance: Select equipment → verify part/CAT/SAP/drawing → check stock/minimum → issue/replace → update stock/history.
